title: Opossum Hub (SharePoint page fallback)
description: Fallback Hub that needs only the SharePoint connector's 'Send an HTTP request to SharePoint' (standard). It creates one modern page, Opossum-Hub.aspx, in the Site Pages library of __SITE_URL__ with a short intro and three List web parts: Opossum Alerts (its 'Open' view: State ne Resolved, newest first), Opossum Snapshot and Opossum Wraps. Then it publishes the page. Read only: it changes no list data. YMCA work tenant only.
prerequisites: The three lists exist on __SITE_URL__ (cloud/lists/*.json), including the Alerts list's 'Open' view, which the Alerts web part shows.

The site has the modern Site Pages feature (step 0 checks for a 'Site Pages' library). A OneDrive personal site (https://<tenant>-my.sharepoint.com/personal/...) normally has no Site Pages library: if step 0 returns 404, this fallback can't run there. Use the Power Apps Hub instead, or ask whether you may use a SharePoint site that you own.

You run the calls yourself, one by one in order, in a flow you build in your own work account (Manually trigger a flow -> one 'Send an HTTP request to SharePoint' action per step, Site Address __SITE_URL__). The connector adds the sign-in and the request digest; add only the headers listed here.

placeholders.__SITE_URL__: your personal SharePoint site URL (Site Address of every call; every uri below is relative to it)
placeholders.__SITE_PATH__: server-relative path of the site, from step 0 (body.ServerRelativeUrl), for example /personal/you_ymca_org or /sites/you
list URL relative to the site (the __LIST_URL_ value without __SITE_PATH__ in front)
placeholders.__VIEW_ID_AlertsOpen__: GUID of the Alerts list's 'Open' view, from step 4
placeholders.__PAGE_ID__: the integer Id of the new page, from step 5
placeholders.__CANVAS_CONTENT_1__: the canvasContent1 array below, after replacing its placeholders, serialized to ONE JSON string (in a flow: string(<the array>) or just paste the escaped text from canvasContent1Escaped)

steps.name: check Site Pages and read the site path

then.expect: 200. A 404 means this site has no modern pages: stop here (see prerequisites).

capture.__LIST_WEBRELURL_Alerts__: the same path with the site's own server-relative path cut off the front (for example /Lists/Opossum Alerts); read the site path in step 0

capture.__LIST_WEBRELURL_Snapshot__: the same path with the site's own server-relative path cut off the front (for example /Lists/Opossum Snapshot); read the site path in step 0

capture.__LIST_WEBRELURL_Wraps__: the same path with the site's own server-relative path cut off the front (for example /Lists/Opossum Wraps); read the site path in step 0

steps.name: read the Alerts 'Open' view (State ne Resolved)
steps.ifMissing: 404 means the view was not created. Create it first with the 'view Open' calls in cloud/lists/opossum-alerts.json (CAML: <Where><Neq><FieldRef Name='State' /><Value Type='Choice'>Resolved</Value></Neq></Where><OrderBy><FieldRef Name='At' Ascending='FALSE' /></OrderBy>), then repeat this step.

steps.name: create the draft page
steps.note: Creates a checked-out draft with a temporary file name. The first save in step 6 names the file after its Title.

steps.name: save the content and name the file Opossum-Hub.aspx
steps.expect: 200 with true. Then step 7 must show Name = Opossum-Hub.aspx.

steps.name: check the file name
steps.expect: body.Name is Opossum-Hub.aspx. If it still has the temporary name, rename the file: POST _api/web/getfilebyserverrelativeurl('__SITE_PATH__/SitePages/<body.Name>')/moveto(newurl='__SITE_PATH__/SitePages/Opossum-Hub.aspx',flags=1) with no body.

steps.name: publish
steps.expect: 200 with true. The page is now at __SITE_URL__/SitePages/Opossum-Hub.aspx.

steps.name: verify what SharePoint stored (optional but recommended)
steps.expect: Open the page in the browser: three list web parts show data. If a web part says 'list not found' or is empty, add one List web part by hand on a test page, read that page's CanvasContent1 the same way, and copy its webPartData.properties shape (SharePoint changes this shape from time to time).

rerun: Running steps 5-8 again creates a second page (SharePoint appends a number to the name). To change the existing page instead: POST _api/sitepages/pages(__PAGE_ID__)/checkoutpage, then steps 6 and 8 again.
canvasContent1Notes: List web part id f92bf067-bc19-489e-a556-7fe95f508720 (built in). Its properties need the list GUID (selectedListId) and URL; the Alerts part also sets selectedViewId to the 'Open' view, so resolved alerts are hidden.
webpartHeightKey picks the web part height (1 = small ... larger numbers are taller); 1 fits the one Snapshot row.
The last entry (controlType 0, pageSettingsSlice) is what SharePoint itself writes at the end of the canvas.
controlType 4 is the built-in Text web part

canvasContent1.innerHTML:
Opossum Hub

Read only. What the work PC reported, alerts that are not resolved yet, and the 4:30 wraps. Fixing a workflow still happens on the PC.
